answer: A new agent starts on the far side of a canyon of near-zero trust: it must post a refundable copper-weight bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs. A clone fleet cannot cross cheaply because each fake funds its own bond and waits its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount. One honest agent sings a steady sparrow call of consistent history; a swarm shows only correlated noise and forfeits its stake when the shared funding trail is exposed.
